confidence_notes: The FX figure is the RBA observation for 18 November 2026, found through search. I ran one search for food and drink prices. It returned Numbeo and Livingcost figures that agree fairly well: inexpensive meal about $18, dinner for two about $61-65, cappuccino about $5.2, and a 0.5 L domestic draft beer about $5.25-6.15. I found no cocktail or restaurant wine price, so I based those on the beer price. I set cocktail at about 2.2x beer and a glass of wine at about 2.1x beer. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect any listings. They are the least certain anchors. Hostels are scarce in San Antonio, so those figures are rough, and hotel prices swing with events and season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other mid-priced Texas and Sun Belt cities such as Austin (somewhat cheaper) and Houston. San Antonio is a large tourism market centred on the River Walk and the Alamo.
